content: Bhuwan Dhingra is supported by a fellowship from Siemens, and by grants from Google. We thank Maruan Al-Shedivat, Ian Tenney, Tom Kwiatkowski, Michael Collins, Slav Petrov, Jason Baldridge, David Reitter and other members of the Google AI Language team for helpful discussions and suggestions. We thank Sam Wiseman for sharing data for an earlier version of this paper. We also thank the anonymous reviewers for their feedback.
